👋 Hi! I'm Moritz Grauer, a graphics programmer and game developer from Karlsruhe, Germany.

I build rendering systems and make games. I've spent the last few years researching ray tracing optimization, building my own rendering engine, and creating games in my spare time. I'm passionate about both the technical side — GPU performance, cache efficiency, low-level optimization — and the creative side of bringing games to life. When I'm not coding, I'm either playing games or doing sports.
